what: Independent replication of the core v2.1 validation. Not a validation report: the pinned report is core2_1_validation_20260924_135542.json and this file changes nothing about it.
how: A second session, unaware of the pinned run, wrote its own core2_1.py from prereg_core2_1.json, downloaded the archives again and ran the validation window on 2026-10-02 (commits b133e0a and 0030bfe on claude/zealous-mayer-eaah8y). Its report was core2_1_validation_20261002_145135.json; it is removed from the working tree so that core2.report_files keeps resolving the pinned report, and stays in git history at 0030bfe.
result: Identical to the pinned report to six decimals on every timeframe: v2.1 trades and mean net R, the rule's trades and mean net R, and the one-sided bootstrap p-value.
same_caveat: The replication used the same 45-bar label tail as the pinned run, so the erratum's finding applies to it too: the last validation trades were resolved on bars from January 2026 (at most 14 days). See core2_1_validation_erratum.json for the numbers cut at 2026-01-01. No verdict changes.
kept_from_that_branch: Only the funding-carry shadow tracker (bot/carry.py, tests/test_carry.py, prereg_carry_shadow.json). The duplicate core2_1.py, train_core2_1.py and test_core2_1.py were dropped in favour of the audited versions.
